title: When the Smile Burns
author: Mirabel Ravensworth
blurb: Sable Eastwick, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
